In 4-cell block units: left notch=block 5, magenta=block 9, right notch=block 11; bar=5 blocks wide.
Most likely level-1 goal I haven't tested: **board center**. Let me sweep the 4 center-adjacent positions (top 28/32 × left 20/24), checking for a win after each.
